d: Pale blonde hair with long straight lengths and straight-cut bangs frames a youthful, mature face with sharp, amber-colored eyes. The build is slender, dressed in a purple tattered dress under a long black pinstripe coat with numerous buckled straps and a large black pointed witch hat with a wide purple underside and silver chain accents. Black knee-high buckled boots complete the look, while a small black cat with glowing eyes sits atop a large, dark purple coffin adorned with chains and a yellow "DEATH" label.
